description: Paginate, slice, or retrieve structured JSON items from any historical Apify Actor run dataset by datasetId or execute any specific GMPSignal Actor slug with offset and limit pagination controls.

actorSlug.description: Optional GMPSignal Actor slug (e.g., "gmpsignal/dex-token-scanner-security-auditor") if fetching fresh paginated items.

datasetId.description: Existing Apify datasetId to paginate (if already executed), or leave empty to run actorSlug.

limit.description: Maximum number of dataset items to return in this page (1 to 250).

offset.description: Zero-based item offset for dataset pagination.

name: fetch_actor_dataset_page
